THE LIMIT, stated so this file is not read as stronger than it is: both judges are qoder/general-purpose, the same model family that authored the 素材 and the questions, so their agreement is correlated error rather than independent confirmation, and no human reader has checked them. For this block that risk is smaller than it is for 長文, because the property that makes a 情報検索 item decidable is machine-checked in check-reading-jouhou.ts (the answer sits in the key line the stem names, no distractor does, and no distractor is readable from a different 素材); the judge leg is here for the half a screen cannot check, which is whether the 問 reads as the lookup it says it is.
